source_item.title: Major forex option expiries set for Tuesday New York cut

card.plain_headline: Key Forex Option Expiries Due Tuesday
card.what_happened: Several significant foreign exchange options contracts are set to expire on Tuesday in New York. These expiries can sometimes influence currency price movements as traders adjust their positions.
card.what_happened_verbose: Major foreign exchange (forex) option contracts with substantial notional values are scheduled to expire on Tuesday, specifically at the New York cut time. Options are derivative contracts that give the buyer the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell a currency at a specific price (strike price) on or before a certain date. When these contracts expire, market participants may need to buy or sell the underlying currency to hedge their positions, potentially leading to increased trading volume and price volatility around the expiry levels.
